analysis.overall: While you spent 72% of the day in target range, it was a bit of a roller coaster with big post-meal spikes followed by sharp drops into low territory.

events.title: Early afternoon low
events.description: Glucose drifted down to a low of 53 mg/dL before temporary target adjustments and carbs brought levels back into range by 2:00 PM.

events.title: Late dinner surge and overnight plunge
events.description: A late 25g meal sent glucose peaking up to 225 mg/dL. Several close correction boluses pulled levels down hard, resulting in a drop to 68 mg/dL around 1:30 AM.

events.title: Smooth morning baseline
events.description: Your blood sugar settled nicely overnight, holding steady in the optimal 70–90 mg/dL range throughout the early morning.

events.title: Breakfast peak followed by steep drop
events.description: A 60g carb breakfast caused a climb to 234 mg/dL. Multiple follow-up doses corrected the peak but eventually triggered a rapid plunge down to 66 mg/dL by early afternoon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be mindful of stacking multiple correction boluses during a post-meal peak, as the combined insulin tends to cause sharp drops a couple of hours later.
